extensions: io.nvuto.extraction preserves exact CSS source, selector, symbol, evidence and revision
deviations: No claim of complete DTCG tool conformance: this fixed-input generator supports the listed types and whole-token curly aliases, not group $extends, property-level references, JSON-pointer $ref or externally supplied token documents. Unsupported constructs are rejected.
Additional string tokens preserve CSS expressions without pretending they are fully structured DTCG shadows/gradients.
Themes are separate token documents merged with shared core; this is project build configuration, not a new DTCG theme syntax.
